purpose: Prevent Atlas findings from reopening existing Agent Memory work merely because terminology differs.

entries.note: A different tombstone representation is not automatically a new logical requirement.
Negative retrieval and influence assertions already have a canonical owner.

entries.finding_family: repetition is not corroboration / self-reinforcing evidence
entries.note: New examples may strengthen adversarial fixtures without creating new doctrine.
Compare outcome semantics before claiming a missing conflict primitive.
Reopen only on a recurring failure not expressible by current lifecycle/currentness/isolation contracts.
A new benchmark matters when it exercises a distinct failure boundary, not because it has a new leaderboard.
Promote only distinct propagation, admission, or recovery failures.
External product success is comparator evidence until exact capability/profile qualification is earned.
Read-path scope alone is weaker than Agent Memory's read/write/derivation/rebuild obligations.
A discrete trust enum is not required merely because another rubric checks for one. Trust remains evidence, not authority.
Physical temporal representation may vary while logical currentness obligations remain.

entries.finding_family: deletion residue / rebuild resurrection / forgetting completeness
entries.note: Provider-local deletion is not transitive Agent Memory forgetting completeness.
Process recovery must reconstruct currentness, scope, deletion, component/profile and pending-obligation state.

entries.finding_family: write-to-readable lag / deferred projection currentness / quiescence
entries.note: This survived the current Atlas dedup pass as a real operational measurement/readiness gap.
Retained procedure, recall activation, action authority, and execution evidence remain separate.
P9 owns structural work/cost; #308 adds visibility-phase and quiescence timing rather than duplicating P9.
